scope.summary: StudioTypeStyle (character-scope and paragraph-scope) is the canonical reusable named-text-style primitive. A StudioTextStory binds character ranges and paragraphs to StudioTypeStyle entries; the story stores the binding plus any local overrides, while definitions live in the StudioStyleRegistry. 14.7 owns the ENGINE that resolves a bound style into concrete character/paragraph attributes (groups 3-6); it does NOT own registry storage, application UI, override/redefine lifecycle, based-on inheritance, or next-style cascade (governed by 14.6/14.10, referenced not duplicated). Support through that binding: paragraph and character styles; based-on inheritance and next-style/following-paragraph cascade; override indicators, redefine-from-selection, clear-overrides; nested/nested-line/GREP styles ([STU-TYP-015]); object/frame styles for area containers.
acceptance_criteria: type-style resolution engine binding StudioTypeStyle/StudioStyleRegistry (no fork); inheritance/next-style/override support; storage upstream
expected_tests: live: bound StudioTypeStyle resolves to concrete char/para attributes; local overrides layered over style
test: based-on inheritance + next-style cascade + override/redefine/clear resolve via engine (registry storage owned upstream, referenced not forked)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No style resolution engine; named styles do not apply; forks StudioTypeStyle storage.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
